Formerly under Gengshi, in Taiyuan he held the handle of goods and wealth; amid sudden crises he occupied office and drew salary for more than twenty years, yet his property grew narrower year by year and his dwelling daily poorer; his household had no store of cloth or silk, and abroad he had no adornment of carriage and horses.

units.zh: 久棲遲於小官，不得舒其所懷。
units.en: For years I stagnated in minor posts, never free to speak what was in my heart.
units.literal: Long lingering in petty offices, unable to stretch forth what he harbors in his breast.

units.zh: 乃作賦自厲，命其篇曰《顯誌》。
units.en: I wrote a rhapsody to brace my own resolve and titled it 'Manifesting My Intent.'
units.literal: Then he composed a fu to steel himself, naming the piece 'Manifesting My Intent.'

units.zh: 所著賦、誄、銘、說、《問交》、《德誥》、《慎情》、書記說、自序、官錄說、策五十篇，肅宗甚重其文。
units.en: He left fifty works—rhapsodies, elegies, inscriptions, essays, along with 'On Friendship,' 'Moral Injunction,' 'Cautious Feelings,' treatises on correspondence, a self-preface, notes on office, and policy papers—and Emperor Zhang thought highly of his prose.
units.literal: What he composed—fu, dirge, inscription, discourse, 'On Friendship,' 'Moral Injunction,' 'Cautious Feelings,' secretary's discourses, self-preface, official record discourse—fifty pieces in all—Emperor Suzong greatly esteemed his writings.

units.zh: 然後闔門講習道德，觀覽乎孔老之論，庶幾乎松、喬之福，上隴阪，陟高岡，遊精宇宙，流目八纮。
units.en: Then I would shut my gate to study moral teaching and read Confucius and Laozi, hoping for something of the blessing of Chisongzi and Wangzi Qiao; I would climb the Long ridges and high hills, send my spirit wandering through heaven and earth, and let my eyes sweep the eight reaches of the world.
units.literal: Then closing the gate he lectured and practiced morality, perused the discourses of Kong and Lao, hoped perhaps for the blessing of [Prince] Song and Wangzi Qiao; ascended the slopes of Long, climbed high ridges, roamed his spirit through the cosmos, let his gaze flow over the eight cords.

units.zh: 建武末，上疏自陳曰：
units.en: Toward the end of Jianwu, he submitted a memorial in his own defense:
units.literal: At the end of the Jianwu era, he submitted a memorial stating his own case, saying:

units.zh: 臣伏念高祖之略而陳平之謀，毀之則疏，譽之則親。
units.en: I reflect on how Gaozu's strategic insight and Chen Ping's counsel worked: speak ill of them and you are pushed aside; speak well of them and you are drawn close.
units.literal: Your minister humbly reflects that Gaozu's strategic grasp and Chen Ping's schemes—if one slanders them, one becomes estranged; if one praises them, one becomes intimate.

units.zh: 以文帝以明而魏尚之忠，繩之以法則為罪，施之以德則為功。
units.en: Consider Emperor Wen's clarity of judgment and Wei Shang's loyalty: judged strictly by the statutes they could be called crimes; weighed with humane virtue they count as service.
units.literal: By Emperor Wen's perspicacity and Wei Shang's loyalty—measured by law they become crime; applied with virtue they become merit.

units.zh: 逮至晚世，董仲舒言道德，見妒於公孫弘，李廣奮節於匈奴，見排於衛青，此忠臣之常所為流涕也。
units.en: In more recent times Dong Zhongshu taught moral principle and was resented by Gongsun Hong; Li Guang held firm against the Xiongnu and was sidelined by Wei Qing—such things are why loyal ministers so often shed tears.
units.literal: Coming down to a later age, Dong Zhongshu spoke of morality and was envied by Gongsun Hong; Li Guang exerted his integrity against the Xiongnu and was squeezed out by Wei Qing—this is what constantly makes loyal ministers weep.

units.zh: 臣衍之先祖，以忠貞之故，成私門之禍。
units.en: My ancestors were ruined in a family tragedy precisely because they stood loyal and true.
units.literal: Your minister Yan's forebears, because of loyalty and steadfastness, brought disaster upon the private household.

units.zh: 衛尉陰興，敬慎周密，內自修敕，外遠嫌疑，故敢與交通。
units.en: Yin Xing, the Commandant of the Guards, was careful and discreet; he cultivated himself within and avoided every shadow of scandal abroad—so I deemed it safe to deal with him.
units.literal: Commandant of the Guards Yin Xing was reverent, cautious, and thorough; inwardly he disciplined himself, outwardly he kept clear of suspicion—therefore I dared to associate with him.

units.zh: 興知臣之貧，數欲本業之。
units.en: He knew I was poor and more than once tried to set me up with land and a livelihood of my own.
units.literal: Xing knew your minister's poverty and repeatedly wished to establish him in a basic livelihood.

units.zh: 於今遭清明之時，飭躬力行之秋，而怨仇叢興，譏議橫世。
units.en: Now, in an age meant for clarity and honest effort, I find myself hemmed in by grudges and smeared by gossip from every side.
units.literal: Now encountering a clear and enlightened time, a season for correcting the person and exerting conduct, yet resentment and enmity arise in clusters, ridicule and criticism fill the age.

units.zh: 蓋富貴易為善，貧賤難為工也。
units.en: The rich and honored find virtue easy; the poor and obscure can scarcely win a fair hearing—no matter how carefully they live.
units.literal: For wealth and honor make it easy to do good; poverty and low status make it hard to achieve refinement.

units.zh: 疏遠壟畝之臣，無望高闕之下，惶恐自陳，以救罪尤。
units.en: I am only a man from the fields, with no access to the high court; in fear and trembling I lay this before you, begging relief from my offenses.
units.literal: A minister distant and far from the furrowed fields has no hope beneath the high palace gates—trembling in fear he states his own case to redeem his faults.

units.zh: 書奏，猶以前過不用。
units.en: The memorial went up, but on account of his past errors he was still not taken back into service.
units.literal: When the document was submitted, still because of former faults he was not employed.

units.zh: 顯誌者，言光明風化之情，昭章玄妙之思也。
units.en: The title refers to bringing one's moral purpose into clear light and giving honest voice to the deepest reflections.
units.literal: 'Manifesting My Intent' means speaking of the disposition of bright enlightenment and transformation, and displaying the thought of the subtle and wondrous.

units.zh: 風興雲蒸，一龍一蛇，與道翺翔，與時變化，夫豈守一節哉？
units.en: Wind rises, clouds gather; one shifts between dragon grandeur and serpent concealment, soaring with the Way and bending with the times—why cling to one rigid pose?
units.literal: Wind rises and clouds steam; now a dragon, now a snake—hovering with the Way, changing with the season—how could one cling to a single principle?

units.zh: 用之則行，舍之則臧，進退無主，屈申無常。
units.en: Called forth, I serve; dismissed, I withdraw; I follow no single patron, stiffening or yielding as circumstance demands.
units.literal: Employed, then act; set aside, then hide; advancing and retreating without a fixed lord, bending and stretching without constancy.

units.zh: 故曰：『有法無法，因時為業，有度無度，與物趣舍。』
units.en: The saying runs: 'Rules and freedom alike serve the moment; measure and abandon measure as things counsel advance or retreat.'
units.literal: Therefore it is said: 'There is method and there is no method—take the season as your enterprise; there is measure and there is no measure—join with things in approaching or leaving.'

units.zh: 常務道德之實，而不求當世之名，闊略杪小之禮，蕩佚人間之事。
units.en: Seek the marrow of the moral life, not the headline of the day; brush aside petty etiquette; do not be snagged by the world's small concerns.
units.literal: One constantly pursues the substance of morality and does not seek fame in the present age; broadly neglects petty minor ritual; lets drift the affairs of the human realm.'

units.zh: 正身直行，恬然肆誌。
units.en: Stand upright, walk a straight path, and let your purpose unfold in calm independence.
units.literal: Correct the body and walk straight; tranquilly give free rein to one's intent.

units.zh: 顧嘗好俶儻之策，時莫能聽用其謀，喟然長嘆，自傷不遭。
units.en: I once pressed daring plans, but my age would not hear them; I can only sigh for a fate that never matched my hopes.
units.literal: Only I once favored bold and generous stratagems; the age could not heed or employ my plans—sighing long, I wound myself for not having met the right time.

units.zh: 抑心折節，意淒情悲。
units.en: I swallowed pride and bent my will; my thoughts turned bleak and my spirit grew heavy.
units.literal: Suppressing the mind, bending the integrity—the intent is bleak, the feeling sad.

units.zh: 夫伐冰之家，不利雞豚之息；
units.en: Great houses commissioned to supply ritual ice do not haggle over pennies from chickens and pigs;
units.literal: Now the house that breaks ice [for the sacrifices] does not seek profit from chickens and pigs;

units.zh: 委積之臣，不操市井之利。
units.en: ministers who oversee the state's granaries do not peddle goods in the market for private gain.
units.literal: the minister who manages granaries does not grasp the profit of the marketplace.

units.zh: 況歷位食祿二十餘年，而財產益狹，居處益貧。
units.en: How much more I, who drew an official income for two decades yet grew poorer every year and narrower in my circumstances.
units.literal: How much more one who has occupied posts and eaten salary for more than twenty years, yet whose property grows ever narrower and dwelling ever poorer.

units.zh: 惟夫君子之仕，行其道也。
units.en: The gentleman enters office only to carry his principles into practice.
units.literal: Only the gentleman's taking office is to practice his Way.

units.zh: 慮時務者不能興其德，為身求者不能成其功，去而歸家，復羈旅於州郡，身愈據職，家彌窮困，卒離饑寒之災，有喪元子之禍。
units.en: Obsessed with current politics, I could not lift my character; scheming for myself, I never finished what I began. I quit and went home, then drifted again from province to province; the higher I climbed in rank, the deeper my family sank—until we faced cold and hunger and the bitter loss of my firstborn.
units.literal: He who weighs the affairs of the age cannot raise his virtue; he who seeks for himself cannot complete his merit. Leaving and returning home, again lodging as a traveler in provinces and commanderies—the more he holds office, the more his household is utterly poor and distressed; in the end he encounters the disaster of hunger and cold, and has the misfortune of losing his eldest son.

units.zh: 先將軍葬渭陵，哀帝之崩也，營之以為園。
units.en: My late father, the general, lay buried at Weiling; when Emperor Ai died the tombs there were expanded into an imperial park.
units.literal: The former general was buried at Weiling; when Emperor Ai died, it was laid out as a park.

units.zh: 於是以新豐之東，鴻門之上，壽安之中，地勢高敞，四通廣大，南望酈山，北屬涇渭，東瞰河華，龍門之陽，三晉之路，西顧酆鄗，周秦之丘，客觀之墟，通視千里，覽見舊都，遂定塋焉。
units.en: So I chose a site east of Xinfeng, above Hongmen, in the Shou'an district—high ground, wide prospects: Mount Li to the south, the Jing and Wei behind me to the north, the Yellow River and Mount Hua eastward, Longmen and the roads of Jin beyond; westward Feng and Hao, the old heights of Zhou and Qin, the wasted splendor of the heartland. From there one sees a thousand li and the old capital itself—that is where I laid the grave.
units.literal: Therefore east of Xinfeng, above Hongmen, within Shou'an—the terrain high and open, extending broadly on four sides—south gazing at Mount Li, north linked to the Jing and Wei, east overlooking the Yellow River and Mount Hua, south of Longmen, on the road of the three Jins; west looking toward Feng and Hao, the mounds of Zhou and Qin, the ruins of Guanzhong—seeing through a thousand li and surveying the old capital—there he fixed the tomb.

units.zh: 退而幽居。
units.en: Then I withdrew and lived in quiet retirement.
units.literal: He withdrew and dwelt in seclusion.

units.zh: 蓋忠臣過故墟而歔欷，孝子入舊室而哀嘆。
units.en: A loyal subject chokes up over ruined ground he once knew; a dutiful son cannot enter an ancestral hall without grief.
units.literal: For the loyal minister passing an old ruin sighs with sobs; the filial son entering an old chamber laments and sighs.

units.zh: 每念祖考，著盛德於前，垂鴻烈於後，遭時之禍，墳墓蕪穢，春秋蒸嘗，昭穆無列，年衰歲暮，悼無成功，將西田牧肥饒之野，殖生產，修孝道，營宗廟，廣祭祀。
units.en: Whenever I think of my ancestors, they displayed abundant virtue before and left great achievements after them, yet they met the calamities of the age: their graves became overgrown and defiled, the spring and autumn steamed and tasted offerings had no proper Zhao and Mu order, and now, with the year declining and old age approaching, I grieve that I have accomplished nothing. I intend to go west to farm and herd in fertile fields, increase my household production, cultivate filial duty, build the ancestral temple, and expand the sacrifices.
units.literal: Whenever he thought of his ancestors and fathers, who displayed abundant virtue before and hung vast merit behind—yet encountered the misfortune of the times, tombs overgrown and foul, spring and autumn offerings and seasonal sacrifices without proper ordering of senior and junior—old in years, late in life, grieving that he had no accomplishment—he intended westward to pasture and farm on fat and fertile wilds, increase livelihood, cultivate filial way, build ancestral temple, broaden sacrifices.

units.zh: 歷觀九州山川之體，追覽上古得失之風，湣道陵遲，傷德分崩。
units.en: I would traverse the nine provinces, study how mountains and rivers lie, and read the ancient record of rise and fall—grieving that the Way had slackened and goodness broken apart.
units.literal: Passing through he observed the forms of the mountains and rivers of the nine provinces; tracing and viewing the winds of gain and loss in high antiquity—he pitied the Way's decline and mourned virtue's fragmentation.

units.zh: 夫睹其終必原其始，故存其人而詠其道。
units.en: To understand how things end you must find how they began; while these men live on in memory, I sing their Way.
units.literal: Now one who sees its end must trace its beginning; therefore preserving the person one hymns his Way.

units.zh: 疆理九野，經營五山，眇然有思陵雲之意。
units.en: I ranged the nine domains and traced the five sacred peaks until my spirit lifted toward the clouds.
units.literal: Delimiting and ordering the nine wilds, managing and arranging the five mountains—dimly he had intent of thought to rise above the clouds.

units.zh: 其辭曰：
units.en: The text runs:
units.literal: The words say:

units.zh: 開歲發春兮，百卉含英。
units.en: The year turns; spring stirs; every stem bears budding flower.
units.literal: The year opens and spring issues forth—ah, the hundred plants hold blossoms.

units.zh: 甲子之朝兮，汨吾西征。
units.en: At dawn on the day jiazi I set my course westward.
units.literal: On the morning of the jiazi day—ah, swiftly I march west.

units.zh: 發軔新豐兮，裴回鎬京。
units.en: I lift the brake at Xinfeng and pace the ruins of old Haojing.
units.literal: I set the carriage brake at Xinfeng—ah, I linger at Haojing.

units.zh: 陵飛廉而太息兮，登平陽而懷傷。
units.en: I pass Feilian with a long sigh; climbing Pingyang, sorrow floods my breast.
units.literal: I mount Feilian and heave a great sigh—ah, I climb Pingyang and harbor sorrow.

units.zh: 悲時俗之險厄兮，哀好惡之無常。
units.en: I lament a treacherous age and the whims that make praise turn overnight into blame.
units.literal: I grieve at the age's customs perilous and straitened—ah, I mourn that likes and dislikes have no constancy.

units.zh: 棄衡石而意量兮，隨風波而飛揚。
units.en: They cast away the fair scale and judge by whim; I am tossed on their shifting currents.
units.literal: Discarding the balance-stone and weighing by intent—ah, following wind and waves I soar.

units.zh: 紛綸流於權利兮，親雷同而妒異；
units.en: The crowd chases power and profit, loves conformity, and hates every distinctive voice;
units.literal: Tangled and flowing toward power and profit—ah, intimate with thunder's echo and jealous of the different;

units.zh: 獨耿介而慕古兮，豈時人之所憙？
units.en: I alone stand apart and look to the ancients—how could this age approve?
units.literal: alone upright and admiring antiquity—ah, how could the men of the age delight in this?

units.zh: 沮先聖之成論兮，□名賢之高風；
units.en: They spurn the settled teaching of the sages and trample the lofty example of the worthy;
units.literal: Blocking the perfected discourse of the former sages—ah, [text missing] the noble wind of renowned worthies;

units.zh: 忽道德之珍麗兮，務富貴之樂耽。
units.en: They neglect true moral beauty and chase the hollow delights of rank and riches.
units.literal: Neglecting the precious splendor of morality—ah, they pursue the indulgent joy of wealth and honor.

units.zh: 遵大路而裴回兮，履孔德之窈冥；
units.en: I keep to the great road and linger there, walking the deep, silent path of true virtue;
units.literal: Following the great road I linger—ah, I tread the subtle darkness of profound virtue;

units.zh: 固眾夫之所眩兮，孰能觀於無形？
units.en: the crowd gawks at glitter—who sees what has no shape?
units.literal: Surely this is what the crowd finds dazzling—ah, who can perceive the formless?

units.zh: 行勁直以離尤兮，羌前人之所有；
units.en: Frank conduct earns reproach—the ancients knew it too;
units.literal: Acting firm and straight thereby meeting blame—ah, indeed this is what the ancients also had;

units.zh: 內自省而不慚兮，遂定誌而弗改。
units.en: yet searching my heart I find no shame; my resolve is set and I will not bend.
units.literal: inwardly examining myself I feel no shame—ah, thus I fix my intent and do not change.

units.zh: 欣吾黨之唐、虞兮，湣吾生之愁勤；
units.en: I exult in the days of Tang and Yu; I pity this anxious life I lead;
units.literal: I rejoice in my kindred's Tang and Yu—ah, I pity my life's anxious toil;

units.zh: 聊發憤而揚情兮，將以蕩夫憂心。
units.en: I voice indignation and let feeling rise, hoping to rinse away this grief.
units.literal: for a while venting indignation and raising feeling—ah, I thereby will wash away care in the heart.

units.zh: 往者不可攀援兮，來者不可與期；
units.en: The past cannot be seized; the future will not be sworn;
units.literal: What is gone cannot be grasped and climbed—ah, what is to come cannot be engaged by appointment;

units.zh: 病沒世之不稱兮，願橫逝而無由。
units.en: I dread leaving the world unsung; I would escape—but find no road.
units.literal: I worry at dying and the age not praising me—ah, I wish to flee sideways yet have no means.

units.zh: 陟雍畤而消搖兮，超略陽而不反。
units.en: I climb the Yong altar and wander free; I pass Lüeyang and may never turn back.
units.literal: I ascend Yongzhi and roam at ease—ah, I leap beyond Lüeyang and do not return.

units.zh: 念人生之不再兮，悲六親之日遠。
units.en: We live but once; my family slips farther from me day by day.
units.literal: I think that human life does not come twice—ah, I grieve that the six kin daily grow distant.

units.zh: 陟九□而臨戔嶭兮，聽涇渭之波聲。
units.en: I climb the Jiuzong heights and look down on the broken ridges; the Jing and Wei sing below me.
units.literal: I ascend the nine [peaks?] and overlook precipitous heights—ah, I listen to the wave-sound of Jing and Wei.

units.zh: 顧鴻門而歔欷兮，哀吾孤之早零，何天命之不純兮，信吾罪之所生；
units.en: I turn toward Hongmen and weep for my child taken young; Heaven's will seems cruel—yet I know my own faults brought this;
units.literal: Looking back at Hongmen I sob—ah, I mourn my orphan's early withering; how is Heaven's mandate not pure—ah, truly from my sins it arose;

units.zh: 傷誠善之無辜兮，賫此恨而入冥。
units.en: the innocent good suffer still; I carry this bitterness into the dark.
units.literal: I wound that the truly good are guiltless—ah, bearing this resentment I enter darkness.

units.zh: 嗟我思之不遠兮，豈則事之可悔？
units.en: Alas, I did not plan far enough—or can any past deed be recalled?
units.literal: Alas that my thought did not reach far—ah, could the deed then be regretted?

units.zh: 雖九死而不眠兮，恐余殃之有再。
units.en: Nine deaths would not close my eyes—I dread worse calamity still.
units.literal: Though nine deaths I do not sleep—ah, I fear my lingering misfortune may come again.

units.zh: 淚汍瀾而雨集兮，氣滂浡而雲披；
units.en: Tears stream like rain; great sobs tear from my chest like wind ripping clouds.
units.literal: Tears surge and collect like rain—ah, my breath breaks in vast gusts like clouds parting;

units.zh: 心怫郁而紆結兮，意沈抑而內悲。
units.en: My heart knots tight; my spirit sinks under inward sorrow.
units.literal: The heart is pent and tangled in knots—ah, the intent is sunk and suppressed with inward grief.

units.zh: 瞰太行之嵯峨兮，觀壺口之崢嶸；
units.en: I look across Taihang's ridges and the fierce gorge at Hukou;
units.literal: I gaze down on Taihang's towering height—ah, I observe Hukou's jagged majesty;

units.zh: 悼丘墓之蕪穢兮，恨昭穆之不榮。
units.en: I grieve for weed-choked graves and the broken order of our ancestral rites.
units.literal: I mourn the tombs' overgrown foulness—ah, I resent that senior and junior lack glory.

units.zh: 歲忽忽而日邁兮，壽冉冉其不與；
units.en: The years race; my allotted span will not wait;
units.literal: The years hurry and daily advance—ah, life slowly does not grant itself;

units.zh: 恥功業之無成兮，赴原野而窮處。
units.en: I blush that I have achieved nothing; I flee to the wilds and hide.
units.literal: I shame at merit and enterprise without completion—ah, I go to the open wilds and dwell in uttermost retreat.

units.zh: 昔伊尹之幹湯兮，七十說而乃信；
units.en: Yi Yin pled his case to Tang seventy times before he was believed;
units.literal: Formerly Yi Yin's seeking Tang—ah, seventy times he spoke and then was trusted;

units.zh: 臯陶釣於雷澤兮，賴虞舜而後親。
units.en: Gao Yao angled in Lei Marsh until Shun raised him up.
units.literal: Gao Yao fished in Lei Marsh—ah, relying on Shun of Yu afterward he became intimate.

units.zh: 無二士之遭遇兮，抱忠貞而莫達；
units.en: Without their timely meeting with power, I hold loyalty to no purpose;
units.literal: Lacking the two men's encounters—ah, embracing loyalty and steadfastness yet not penetrating;

units.zh: 率妻子而耕耘兮，委厥美而不伐。
units.en: I lead my family at the plough and bury my gifts unsung.
units.literal: Leading wife and children I plow and weed—ah, I entrust my excellence and do not boast.

units.zh: 韓盧抑而不縱兮，騏驥絆而不試；
units.en: The keen hound is held leashed; the swift horse stands tethered, never raced;
units.literal: Han Lu is checked and not unleashed—ah, the thoroughbred is hobbled and not tried;

units.zh: 獨慷慨而遠覽兮，非庸庸之所識。
units.en: I alone rage and scan the distance—things the petty never grasp.
units.literal: Alone generous of spirit and gazing far—ah, not what the commonplace recognize.

units.zh: 卑衛賜之阜貨兮，高顏回之所慕；
units.en: I scorn Zigong's clever wealth and lift what Yan Hui loved;
units.literal: I deem low Zigong's piled goods—ah, I exalt what Yan Hui admired;

units.zh: 重祖考之洪烈兮，故收功於此路。
units.en: My forebears' great deed weighs on me; on this path I seek to finish their work.
units.literal: I weigh heavy my ancestors' vast merit—ah, therefore I gather achievement on this road.

units.zh: 循四時之代謝兮，分五土之刑德；
units.en: I follow the turning seasons and read each soil's blessing or bane;
units.literal: Following the four seasons' succession—ah, I distinguish the five soils' virtue and severity;

units.zh: 林相麓之所產兮，嘗水泉之所殖。
units.en: I note what woods and foothills yield and sample what spring-water raises.
units.literal: Forests matching foothills' produce—ah, I taste what springs and streams nourish.

units.zh: 修神農之本業兮，采軒轅之奇策；
units.en: I return to Shennong's husbandry and borrow the Yellow Emperor's craft;
units.literal: I cultivate Shennong's basic occupation—ah, I adopt Xuanyuan's strange stratagems;

units.zh: 追周棄之遺教兮，軼范蠡之絕跡。
units.en: I follow the grain god's ancient lesson and leave Fan Li's track behind.
units.literal: I pursue Zhouqi's remaining teaching—ah, I pass beyond Fan Li's vanished tracks.

units.zh: 陟隴山以逾望兮，眇然覽於八荒；
units.en: I climb Longshan and strain my sight across the eight reaches;
units.literal: I ascend Long Mountain to gaze beyond—ah, dimly I survey the eight wilds;

units.zh: 風波飄其並興兮，情惆悵而增傷。
units.en: Wind and wave surge together; my heart aches more.
units.literal: Wind and waves whirl and rise together—ah, feeling is melancholy and adds wound.

units.zh: 覽河華之泱漭兮，望秦晉之故國。
units.en: The Yellow River and Mount Hua spread vast; I look toward the lost realms of Qin and Jin.
units.literal: I view the Yellow River and Mount Hua vast and boundless—ah, I gaze on Qin and Jin's old states.

units.zh: 憤馮亭之不遂兮，慍去疾之遭惑。
units.en: I rage that Feng Ting's plan miscarried and smart at Quji's fatal mistake.
units.literal: I resent Feng Ting's not succeeding—ah, I am angry at Quji's encountering delusion.

units.zh: 流山嶽而周覽兮，徇碣石與洞庭；
units.en: I drift past sacred peaks, circle Jieshi, sweep toward Dongting;
units.literal: Flowing mountains and peaks I scan all around—ah, I follow Jieshi and Dongting;

units.zh: 浮江河而入海兮，溯淮濟而上征。
units.en: I ride the great rivers to the sea, then trace the Huai and Ji upstream.
units.literal: Floating the Yangtze and Yellow River I enter the sea—ah, I trace Huai and Ji upward in expedition.

units.zh: 瞻燕齊之舊居兮，歷宋楚之名都；
units.en: I pass Yan and Qi's old seats and Song and Chu's storied towns;
units.literal: I look upon Yan and Qi's old dwellings—ah, I pass through Song and Chu's famous capitals;

units.zh: 哀群後之不祀兮，痛列國之為墟。
units.en: I mourn kings without heirs and kingdoms ground to dust.
units.literal: I mourn the many lords' lack of sacrifice—ah, I grieve the feudal states become ruins.

units.zh: 馳中夏而升降兮，路紆軫而多艱；
units.en: I race the heartland's rises and falls on roads that twist and fight me;
units.literal: Galloping the central Xia I rise and descend—ah, the road winds and turns with much hardship;

units.zh: 講聖哲之通論兮，心愊憶而紛紜。
units.en: I rehearse the sages' great themes until my heart knots with tangled thought.
units.literal: I expound the sage-wise men's penetrating discourse—ah, the heart is depressed and memories confused.

units.zh: 惟天路之同軌兮，或帝王之異政；
units.en: Heaven's law runs one track, yet kings rule each in his own way;
units.literal: Only Heaven's road shares one track—ah, or emperors and kings have differing government;

units.zh: 堯、舜煥其蕩蕩兮，禹承平而革命。
units.en: Yao and Shun shone with effortless breadth; Yu took a settled age and forged a new mandate.
units.literal: Yao and Shun blaze with their vast vastness—ah, Yu received peace and changed the mandate.

units.zh: 並日夜而幽思兮，終悇憛而洞疑；
units.en: Day and night I brood until anxiety hollows me out;
units.literal: Together day and night I darkly ponder—ah, in the end anxious and pierced with doubt;

units.zh: 高陽□其超遠兮，世孰可與論茲？
units.en: Gaoyang's line rose remote as heaven—who alive can weigh such things with me?
units.literal: Gaoyang [text missing] his transcendently distant—ah, in the age who can discuss this with me?

units.zh: 訊夏啟於甘澤兮，傷帝典之始傾；
units.en: I question Qi of Xia by Gan Pool and mourn where the golden age first cracked;
units.literal: I question Xia Qi at Gan marsh—ah, I wound at the imperial norm's beginning to tilt;

units.zh: 頌成、康之載德兮，詠《南風》之歌聲。
units.en: I hymn Cheng and Kang's virtue and the tune of the 'South Wind.'
units.literal: I praise Cheng and Kang's bearing virtue—ah, I chant the 'South Wind' song's sound.

units.zh: 思唐、虞之晏晏兮，揖稷、契與為朋；
units.en: I dwell on the calm of Yao and Shun's age and would take Hou Ji and Xie as my companions;
units.literal: I think of Yao and Shun's peace and ease—ah, I bow to Ji and Xie and make them friends;

units.zh: 苗裔紛其條暢兮，至湯、武而勃興。
units.en: Their line branched and flourished until Tang and Wu burst forth in power.
units.literal: Offspring and shoots profusely their branches spread—ah, down to Tang and Wu they surged to rise.

units.zh: 昔三後之純粹兮，每季世而窮禍；
units.en: The three ancient kings were utterly good—yet each dynasty ended in ruin;
units.literal: Formerly the three rulers' purity—ah, each late age met utmost calamity;

units.zh: 吊夏桀於南巢兮，哭殷紂於牧野。
units.en: I mourn Jie of Xia besieged at Southern Nest and Zhou of Yin defeated at Muye.
units.literal: I console Xia Jie at Southern Nest—ah, I weep for Yin Zhou at Muye.

units.zh: 詔伊尹於亳郊兮，享呂望於酆州；
units.en: I call Yi Yin from the outskirts of Bo and feast Lü Wang by Fengzhou;
units.literal: I summon Yi Yin at Bo's outskirts—ah, I feast Lü Wang at Fengzhou;

units.zh: 功與日月齊光兮，名與三王爭流。
units.en: Their deeds shone with sun and moon; their fame runs alongside the three sage kings.
units.literal: Merit with sun and moon shares light—ah, name with the three kings vies in flowing.

units.zh: 楊朱號乎衢路兮，墨子泣乎白絲；
units.en: Yang Zhu cried out at the crossroads; Mozi wept for silk turned from white;
units.literal: Yang Zhu wails on the crossroads—ah, Mozi weeps over white silk;

units.zh: 知漸染之易性兮，怨造作之弗思。
units.en: They knew how habit alters the heart, and grieved that people plot without reflection.
units.literal: Knowing gradual dyeing changes nature—ah, I resent contrivance that does not think.

units.zh: 美《關雎》之識微兮，湣王道之將崩；
units.en: I honor how the 'Guan ju' read the small signs; I pity the royal way as it crumbled;
units.literal: I praise the 'Guan ju's' perceiving the subtle—ah, I pity the kingly way about to collapse;

units.zh: 拔周唐之盛德兮，捃桓、文之譎功。
units.en: I lift up the great virtue of the Zhou founders and collect the cunning triumphs of Huan and Wen.
units.literal: I pluck Zhou and Tang's abundant virtue—ah, I gather Huan and Wen's crafty achievements.

units.zh: 忿戰國之遘禍兮，憎權臣之擅強；
units.en: I rage at the disasters of the Warring States and hate ministers who seized strength for themselves;
units.literal: I resent the Warring States' meeting calamity—ah, I hate powerful ministers' usurping strength;

units.zh: 黜楚子於南郢兮，執趙武於湨梁。
units.en: I cast down the lord of Chu at his southern capital and hold Zhao Wu to account at Ju-liang.
units.literal: I dismiss the Chu lord at southern Ying—ah, I seize Zhao Wu at Ju-liang.

units.zh: 善忠信之救時兮，惡詐謀之妄作；
units.en: I praise loyalty that saves the times and despise hollow stratagems;
units.literal: I approve loyalty and good faith that rescue the age—ah, I hate deceitful plots' reckless making;

units.zh: 聘申叔於陳蔡兮，禽荀息於虞虢。
units.en: I would summon Shen Shu from Chen and Cai and seize Xun Xi where Yu and Guo fell;
units.literal: I engage Shen Shu in Chen and Cai—ah, I capture Xun Xi at Yu and Guo.

units.zh: 誅犁鋤之介聖兮，討臧倉之訴知；
units.en: I would punish Li Chu for obstructing the sage and chastise Zang Cang for slandering the wise;
units.literal: I punish Li's stubborn saintliness—ah, I chastise Zang Cang's accusing wisdom;

units.zh: 巽子反於彭城兮，爵管仲於夷儀。
units.en: I judge Zifan at Pengcheng and raise Guan Zhong at Yiyi with a noble title;
units.literal: I humiliate Zifan at Pengcheng—ah, I ennoble Guan Zhong at Yiyi.

units.zh: 疾兵革之浸滋兮，苦攻伐之萌生；
units.en: I loathe the steady spread of war and the endless rise of campaigns;
units.literal: I hate arms and leather's gradual spread—ah, I suffer attack and invasion's sprouting birth;

units.zh: 沈孫武於五湖兮，斬白起於長平。
units.en: I would drown Sun Wu in the five lakes and strike down Bai Qi at Changping.
units.literal: I sink Sun Wu in the five lakes—ah, I behead Bai Qi at Changping.

units.zh: 惡叢巧之亂世兮，毒從橫之敗俗；
units.en: I abhor the tricks that disorder the world and the alliance arts that poisoned custom;
units.literal: I hate clustered craftiness that disorders the age—ah, I poison vertical-horizontal alliance's ruining custom;

units.zh: 流蘇秦於洹水兮，幽張儀於鬼谷。
units.en: I would cast Su Qin into the Huan and shut Zhang Yi away in Ghost Valley.
units.literal: I banish Su Qin to the Huan waters—ah, I imprison Zhang Yi in Ghost Valley.

units.zh: 澄德化之陵遲兮，烈刑罰之峭峻；
units.en: I mourn how moral influence faded and how cruel punishments flamed;
units.literal: I clarify virtue-transforming's decline—ah, I blaze punishments' sheer harshness;

units.zh: 燔商鞅之法術兮，燒韓非之說論。
units.en: I would burn Shang Yang's statutes and consume Han Fei's treatises in flame.
units.literal: I burn Shang Yang's methods—ah, I scorch Han Fei's discourse.

units.zh: 誚始皇之跋扈兮，投李斯於四裔；
units.en: I deride the First Emperor's tyranny and banish Li Si to the farthest frontier;
units.literal: I mock First Emperor's domineering—ah, I cast Li Si to the four wilds;

units.zh: 滅先王之法則兮，禍浸淫而弘大。
units.en: They wiped out the laws of the ancient kings until disaster spread without end.
units.literal: They extinguished former kings' norms—ah, disaster seeped and spread vast.

units.zh: 援前聖以制中兮，矯二主之驕奢；
units.en: I take the ancient sages as my measure and rebuke the pride and excess of two rulers;
units.literal: Drawing former sages to establish the mean—ah, I correct the two lords' arrogance and luxury;

units.zh: 馌女齊於絳臺兮，饗椒舉於章華。
units.en: I feed Nü Qi at the Jiang terrace and feast Jiao Ju at Zhanghua Pavilion;
units.literal: I bring provisions to Nü Qi at Jiang Terrace—ah, I feast Jiao Ju at Zhanghua.

units.zh: 摛道德之光耀兮，匡衰世之眇風；
units.en: I would unfold the light of the Way and set right the puny temper of a failing age;
units.literal: I spread morality's brightness—ah, I rectify a declining age's feeble wind;

units.zh: 褒宋襄於泓谷兮，表季劄於延陵。
units.en: I honor Duke Xiang of Song at Hong and raise up Jizha of Yanling as a model;
units.literal: I praise Duke Xiang of Song at Hong valley—ah, I display Jizha at Yanling.

units.zh: 摭仁智之英華兮，激亂國之末流；
units.en: I gather the flower of humanity and insight and try to stir the dying tide of ruined states;
units.literal: I gather benevolence and wisdom's flower—ah, I stir chaotic states' dying current;

units.zh: 觀鄭僑於溱洧兮，訪晏嬰於營丘。
units.en: I watch Zichan by the Zhen and Wei and seek Yan Ying at Yingqiu.
units.literal: I observe Zichan at Zhen and Wei—ah, I visit Yan Ying at Yingqiu.

units.zh: 日曀曀其將暮兮，獨於邑而煩惑；
units.en: The sun sinks in haze; alone in my hamlet I fret and lose my way;
units.literal: The sun dimly is about to set—ah, alone I am vexed and troubled in the town;

units.zh: 夫何九州之博大兮，迷不知路之南北；
units.en: How wide the nine regions—yet I cannot tell south from north;
units.literal: How vast the nine provinces' breadth—ah, lost I know not road's south or north;

units.zh: 駟素□而馳聘兮，乘翠雲而相佯；
units.en: My team of white horses flies; I ride the green clouds and roam at ease;
units.literal: Four plain [text missing] horses gallop—ah, I ride emerald clouds and wander;

units.zh: 就伯夷而折中兮，得務光而愈明。
units.en: I seek Boyi for balance and find Wuguang until my purpose shines clearer.
units.literal: I approach Boyi to find the mean—ah, I obtain Wuguang and grow clearer.

units.zh: 款子高於中野兮，遇伯成而定慮；
units.en: I call on Zigao in the open fields and meet Bocheng until my mind steadies;
units.literal: I knock for Zigao in the central wild—ah, I meet Bocheng and settle intent;

units.zh: 欽真人之德美兮，淹躊躇而弗去。
units.en: I marvel at the worthies' virtue and linger, unable to tear myself away.
units.literal: I admire the perfected man's virtue and beauty—ah, I linger hesitant and do not leave.

units.zh: 意斟愖而不淡兮，俟回風而容與；
units.en: My heart is anxious and never light; I wait on the turning wind and drift;
units.literal: Intent cautious and not bland—ah, I await the whirlwind and wander easy;

units.zh: 求善卷之所存兮，遇許由於負黍。
units.en: I search for Shan Juan's dwelling and meet Xu You at Fushu.
units.literal: I seek Shan Juan's whereabouts—ah, I meet Xu You at Fushu.

units.zh: 軔吾車於箕陽兮，秣吾馬於潁滸；
units.en: I halt my carriage at Jiyang and water my horses by the Ying;
units.literal: I set my carriage brake at Jiyang—ah, I feed my horses at Ying's shore;

units.zh: 聞至言而曉領兮，還吾反乎故宇。
units.en: Perfect teaching clears my mind; I turn back toward my home.
units.literal: Hearing utmost words I understand—ah, I return and turn back to my old house.

units.zh: 覽天地之幽奧兮，統萬物之維綱；
units.en: I scan heaven and earth's hidden depths and grasp the threads that bind all things;
units.literal: I view heaven and earth's hidden depth—ah, I comprehend the myriad things' guiding cords;

units.zh: 究陰陽之變化兮，昭五德之精光。
units.en: I trace how yin and yang turn and show the bright essence of the five powers.
units.literal: I investigate yin and yang's transformations—ah, I display the five virtues' essential light.

units.zh: 躍青龍於滄海兮，豢白虎於金山；
units.en: The azure dragon leaps from the deep sea; the white tiger is fed on Golden Mountain;
units.literal: I leap the azure dragon on the grey sea—ah, I rear the white tiger on gold mountain;

units.zh: 鑿巖石而為室兮，托高陽以養仙。
units.en: I hollow stone for a chamber and trust Gaoyang's line to school my soul toward transcendence.
units.literal: I cut rock to make a chamber—ah, I entrust myself to Gaoyang to nurture immortals.

units.zh: 神雀翔於鴻崖兮，玄武潛於嬰冥；
units.en: The sacred bird wheels above Hong cliff; the Dark Warrior lurks in utter gloom;
units.literal: The divine sparrow soars at Hong cliff—ah, the Dark Warrior hides in deep gloom;

units.zh: 伏朱樓而四望兮，采三秀之華英。
units.en: From a red tower I scan the world and pluck the splendid blooms of the immortals' herb.
units.literal: I crouch in vermilion tower and gaze four ways—ah, I gather three beauties' splendid blossoms.

units.zh: 篡前修之誇節兮，曜往昔之光勛；
units.en: I claim the great integrity of the ancients and let their old glory shine again;
units.literal: I seize former cultivate men's boastful integrity—ah, I shine former times' gleaming merit;

units.zh: 披綺季之麗服兮，揚屈原之靈芬。
units.en: I don the fair robes of Qiji and breathe Qu Yuan's haunting virtue.
units.literal: I put on Qiji's lovely garments—ah, I raise Qu Yuan's spirit fragrance.

units.zh: 高吾寇之岌岌兮，長吾佩之洋洋；
units.en: My tall crown rises steeply; my long pendants sway with easy grace;
units.literal: I raise high my crown's perilous peak—ah, I lengthen my pendants' flowing sway;

units.zh: 飲六醴之清液兮，食五芝之茂英。
units.en: I drink the six pure nectars and feed on the five magic fungi in bloom.
units.literal: I drink six sweet wines' clear liquid—ah, I eat five mushrooms' lush blossoms.

units.zh: 揵六枳而為籬兮，築蕙若而為室；
units.en: I fence my plot with six rows of bitter-orange and roof my cell with orchid and ruo;
units.literal: I weave six trifoliate oranges as fence—ah, I build huiru orchids as chamber;

units.zh: 播蘭芷於中廷兮，列杜衡於外術。
units.en: I plant orchid and iris in the courtyard and line the outer walk with duheng;
units.literal: I sow orchid and iris in the inner court—ah, I array duheng along the outer path.

units.zh: 攢射幹雜蘼蕪兮，構木蘭與新夷；
units.en: I mix shegan with miju and weave magnolia with fragrant bay;
units.literal: I cluster shegan mixed with miju—ah, I construct magnolia with xinyi;

units.zh: 光扈扈而煬燿兮，紛郁郁而暢美；
units.en: Light blazes and dazzles; fragrance spreads rich and sweet;
units.literal: Light blazing and dazzling—ah, profusely lush and smoothly beautiful;

units.zh: 華芳曄其發越兮，時恍忽而莫貴；
units.en: The blossoms flare with scent—yet in this drifting hour nothing seems worth cherishing;
units.literal: Flowers' fragrance brightly bursts forth—ah, the season flickers and nothing is prized;

units.zh: 非惜身之埳軻兮，憐眾美之憔悴。
units.en: Not that I cling to ease for myself—I grieve that every lovely thing wilts.
units.literal: It is not cherishing the body's hardship—ah, I pity the many beauties' withering.

units.zh: 遊精神於大宅兮，抗玄妙之常操；
units.en: I let my spirit roam the vast inward hall and hold fast to the subtle constant Way;
units.literal: I roam spirit in the great lodging—ah, I uphold dark subtlety's constant conduct;

units.zh: 處清靜以養誌兮，實吾心之所樂。
units.en: In quiet clarity I cultivate my purpose—this is what my heart truly loves.
units.literal: Dwelling in clarity and stillness to nurture intent—ah, truly my heart's delight.

units.zh: 山峨峨而造天兮，林冥冥而暢茂；
units.en: Peaks rear toward heaven; the woods stand dark and thick;
units.literal: Mountains lofty reach heaven—ah, forests dark and deep flourish lush;

units.zh: 鸞回翔索其群兮，鹿哀鳴而求其友。
units.en: Phoenix wheels, calling its kind; deer cry out for companions.
units.literal: The phoenix wheels seeking its flock—ah, the deer sadly cries seeking its mate.

units.zh: 誦古今以散思兮，覽聖賢以自鎮；
units.en: I read past and present to clear my mind and study the sages to steady my soul;
units.literal: I chant past and present to scatter thought—ah, I view sages and worthies to steady myself;

units.zh: 嘉孔丘之知命兮，大老聃之貴玄；
units.en: I honor Kong Qiu's acceptance of fate and Laozi's reverence for the hidden Way;
units.literal: I praise Kong Qiu's knowing Heaven's mandate—ah, I magnify Old Dan's esteeming the dark;

units.zh: 德與道其孰寶兮；
units.en: Which shall we treasure—virtue or the Way?
units.literal: Virtue and the Way—which is the treasure—ah;

units.zh: 名與身其孰親？
units.en: Which is closer—reputation or one's own life?
units.literal: Fame and the person—which is intimate?

units.zh: 陂山谷而閑處兮，守寂寞而存神。
units.en: I terrace hills and valleys and live withdrawn, guarding stillness and sustaining spirit.
units.literal: I slope hills and valleys and dwell at leisure—ah, I guard silence and preserve spirit.

units.zh: 夫莊周之釣魚兮，辭卿相之顯位；
units.en: Zhuang Zhou angled by the river and refused the highest offices;
units.literal: Now Zhuang Zhou's fishing—ah, declining minister and chancellor's eminent posts;

units.zh: 於陵子之灌園兮，似至人之仿佛。
units.en: Yulingzi watered his garden—almost the figure of a perfect sage.
units.literal: Yulingzi's watering garden—ah, resembling the perfected man's semblance.

units.zh: 蓋隱約而得道兮，羌窮悟而入術；
units.en: In modest retreat one finds the Way; at the limit of insight one masters the craft.
units.literal: For hidden dimly one obtains the Way—ah, indeed in utmost enlightenment one enters the art;

units.zh: 離塵垢之窈冥兮，配喬、松之妙節。
units.en: I leave the world's grime behind and aspire to the purity of Wangzi Qiao and Chisongzi.
units.literal: Leaving dust and filth's deep gloom—ah, I match Qiao and Song's subtle integrity.

units.zh: 惟吾誌之所庶兮，固與俗其不同；
units.en: What my heart hopes for has never matched the vulgar world;
units.literal: Only my intent's hoped-for goal—ah, surely with custom it is not the same;

units.zh: 既俶儻而高引兮，願觀其從容。
units.en: Already I stand apart on high ground—I would watch how ease unfolds.
units.literal: Already bold and loftily withdrawn—ah, I wish to observe its ease.

units.zh: 然有大誌，不戚戚於賤貧。
units.en: Yet he nursed great ambitions and did not fret over poverty or low rank.
units.literal: Yet he had great intent and was not anxious over lowliness and poverty.

units.zh: 居貧年老，卒於家。
units.en: He lived poor and old and died at home.
units.literal: Dwelling poor and old in years, he died at home.

units.zh: 後母惡之，嘗因豹夜寐，欲行毒害，豹逃走得免。
units.en: His stepmother hated him; once while he slept she tried to poison him, but he woke and fled to safety.
units.literal: His stepmother hated him; once taking advantage of Bao's sleeping at night she wished to carry out poison harm—Bao fled and escaped.

units.zh: 三公之貴，千金之富，不得其願，不概於懷。
units.en: I never reached the honor of the Three Dukes nor wealth counted in gold—but because they were not what I truly sought, I do not resent their absence.
units.literal: The three dukes' nobility, a thousand gold's wealth—if he did not obtain his wish, he did not harbor them in his breast.

units.zh: 貧而不衰，賤而不恨，年雖疲曳，猶庶幾名賢之風。
units.en: Poor but not broken, humble but not bitter—though age wears me down, I still hope to walk in the footsteps of the worthies.
units.literal: Poor yet not declining, low yet not resentful—although years are weary and dragged, still perhaps near renowned worthies' wind.

units.zh: 修道德於幽冥之路，以終身名，為後世法。』
units.en: I polish character along hidden paths, that my name may endure and later ages may take me as their pattern."
units.literal: I cultivate morality on dark hidden roads, thereby to complete life's name, as model for later generations.'

units.zh: 論曰：夫貴者負勢而驕人，才士負能而遺行，其大略然也。
units.en: The historian remarks: the privileged rely on rank and slight others; clever men trust their gifts and neglect conduct—that is the usual pattern.
units.literal: The judgment says: Now the noble rely on position and are arrogant to others; talented men rely on ability and abandon conduct—their general outline is thus.

units.zh: 二子不其然乎！
units.en: Were not these two men exactly such cases!
units.literal: Did not the two sons conform to this!

units.zh: 夫然，義直所以見屈於既往，守節故亦彌阻於來情。
units.en: So it is: an unbending sense of right explains the slights of the past, and clinging to principle will only draw harder resistance from the world to come.
units.literal: Thus it is that righteous straightness is the reason for being humiliated in what is past, and preserving integrity therefore is also ever more blocked in what is to come in feeling.

units.zh: 永平中，車駕近出，而信陽侯陰就幹突禁衛，車府令徐匡鉤就車，收禦者送獄。
units.en: During Yongping the emperor rode out on a short tour; Marquis Yin Jiu of Xinyang forced his way through the palace guard; carriage-house director Xu Kuang seized his chariot and jailed the charioteer.
units.literal: In the Yongping period, the imperial carriage went out on a near excursion, and Marquis of Xinyang Yin Jiu burst through the forbidden guard; the carriage-house director Xu Kuang hooked Jiu's carriage and arrested the driver and sent him to prison.

units.zh: 良上言曰：『信陽侯就倚恃外戚，幹犯乘輿，無人臣禮，為大不敬。
units.en: Wu Liang memorialized: 'Yin Jiu trades on his status as an imperial in-law, obstructs the imperial train, and shows none of a subject's deference—that is grave disrespect.'
units.literal: Liang submitted words, saying, 'Marquis of Xinyang Jiu relies on being maternal kin, violates the imperial equipage, lacks the ritual of minister and subject, and is greatly irreverent.'

units.zh: 數稱達名士王駿、韋安世、王延世等，救解馮野王、王尊、胡常之罪過，及繼功臣絕世，填撫四夷，當世善政，多出於欽者。
units.en: He repeatedly praised worthy men such as Wang Jun, Wei Anshi, and Wang Yanshi to high office, cleared Feng Yewang, Wang Zun, and Hu Chang of unjust charges, restored titles to meritorious families whose lines had failed, and soothed the frontier tribes—most of the era's sound policies owed something to Du Qin.
units.literal: Repeatedly he praised and advanced noted gentlemen Wang Jun, Wei Anshi, Wang Yanshi, and others, rescued and explained the faults of Feng Yewang, Wang Zun, and Hu Chang, and as to continuing meritorious ministers' cut-off lines, filling and soothing the four barbarians—good government of the age mostly came from Qin.

units.zh: 平帝立，寶為大司農。
units.en: Under Pingdi he ran the granaries as grand minister of agriculture.
units.literal: When Emperor Ping was established, Bao became grand minister of agriculture.

units.zh: 季布，楚人也，為任俠有名。
units.en: Ji Bu was a native of Chu who had won renown as a knight-errant.
units.literal: Ji Bu was a man of Chu; as a knight-errant he had a reputation.

units.zh: 項籍滅，高祖購求布千金，敢有舍匿，罪三族。
units.en: After Xiang Yu fell, Gaozu posted a reward of a thousand pounds of gold for Ji Bu, with death for three generations of kin for anyone who dared hide him.
units.literal: When Xiang Ji was destroyed, Gaozu offered a thousand catties of gold for Ji Bu; whoever dared shelter or conceal him would suffer punishment extending to three kin groups.

units.zh: 朱家心知其季布也，買置田舍。
units.en: Zhu Jia recognized him at once as Ji Bu, bought him, and lodged him on a country estate.
units.literal: Zhu Jia in his heart knew he was Ji Bu; he bought him and placed him in a field house.

units.zh: 乃之雒陽見汝陰侯滕公，說曰：「季布何罪？
units.en: Then he traveled to Luoyang to see Xiahou Ying, the Marquis of Ru-yin, and argued, "What wrong has Ji Bu done?
units.literal: Thereupon he went to Luoyang to see the Marquis of Ru-yin, Lord Teng, and urged him, saying, "What crime has Ji Bu committed?

units.zh: 且以季布之賢，漢求之急如此，此不北走胡，南走越耳。
units.en: A man of Ji Bu's caliber, pressed this hard, will flee north to the Xiongnu or south to Nanyue.
units.literal: Moreover, by Ji Bu's worthiness, the Han's search for him being so urgent—this is nothing but fleeing north to the Hu or fleeing south to Yue.

units.zh: 當是時，諸公皆多布能摧剛為柔，朱家亦以此名聞當世。
units.en: Men of rank admired Ji Bu for bending unyielding pride into survival, and Zhu Jia's name rang through the age for it.
units.literal: At this time, the various lords all praised Bu for being able to break hardness and make softness; Zhu Jia also by this had his name heard in that age.

units.zh: 布聞，寄書諫長君曰：「吾聞曹丘生非長者，勿與通。」
units.en: When Ji Bu heard of it, he wrote to Dou Changjun warning him, "Cao Qiusheng is no man of substance; have nothing to do with him."
units.literal: Ji Bu heard of this and sent a letter admonishing Dou Changjun: "I have heard that Cao Qiusheng is not a venerable elder; do not associate with him."

units.zh: 曹丘至，則揖布曰：「楚人諺曰『得黃金百，不如得季布諾』，足下何以得此聲梁楚之間哉？
units.en: When Cao arrived, he bowed to Ji Bu and said, "Chu has a saying: 'A hundred pounds of gold cannot buy Ji Bu's word'—how did you earn such fame across Liang and Chu?
units.literal: When Cao Qiu arrived, then he bowed to Bu and said, "The men of Chu have a proverb: 'Obtaining yellow gold a hundred is not as good as obtaining Ji Bu's promise'—how did you obtain this reputation between Liang and Chu?

units.zh: 布弟季心氣蓋關中，遇人恭謹，為任俠，方數千里，士爭為死。
units.en: Ji Bu's younger brother Ji Xin overshadowed all Guanzhong in sheer force of character; in person he was courteous and restrained, yet as a knight-errant his reputation ran for a thousand miles, and fighting men vied to die for him.
units.literal: Bu's younger brother Ji Xin, spirit covering Guanzhong, meeting people was respectful and careful; as knight-errant, square several thousand li, gentlemen strove to die for him.

units.zh: 當是時，季心以勇，布以諾，聞關中。
units.en: In those days Guanzhong knew Ji Xin for his courage and Ji Bu for keeping his word.
units.literal: At this time, Ji Xin by bravery, Bu by promise, were heard of in Guanzhong.

units.zh: 布母弟丁公，為項羽將，逐窘高祖彭城西。
units.en: Ji Bu's maternal uncle Ding Gong, a general under Xiang Yu, had pressed Gaozu hard west of Pengcheng.
units.literal: Ji Bu's maternal uncle Ding Gong, being Xiang Yu's general, pursued and cornered Gaozu west of Pengcheng.

units.zh: 贊曰：以項羽之氣，而季布以勇顯名楚，身履軍搴旗者數矣，可謂壯士。
units.en: The historian's verdict: In an age dominated by Xiang Yu's fury, Ji Bu won fame in Chu for raw courage; he repeatedly charged into battle and tore enemy banners from their poles—a true fighting man.
units.literal: The appraisal says: By Xiang Yu's fierce spirit, yet Ji Bu by bravery displayed name in Chu; personally in the army seizing banners—several times—can be called a brave warrior.

units.zh: 竇長君曰：「季將軍不說足下，足下無往。」
units.en: Dou Changjun said, "General Ji dislikes you; you had better not go."
units.literal: Dou Changjun said, "General Ji is not pleased with you; you must not go."

units.zh: 項籍使將兵，數窘漢王。
units.en: Xiang Yu put him in command of troops, and time and again he cornered the King of Han.
units.literal: Xiang Ji had him lead troops, and he repeatedly embarrassed the King of Han.

units.zh: 彼自負其材，受辱不羞，欲有所用其未足也，故終為漢名將。
units.en: He trusted his own abilities; shame did not break him because he still meant to put his gifts to use. In the end he became one of the Han's celebrated generals.
units.literal: He himself bore his talents; receiving humiliation he was not ashamed, wishing to have something to use of what was not yet sufficient; therefore in the end he became a Han famous general.

units.zh: 布召見，謝，拜郎中。
units.en: Ji Bu was summoned to court, thanked the emperor, and was appointed a gentleman of the palace.
units.literal: Bu was summoned and seen; he thanked; he was appointed gentleman of the palace.

units.zh: 孝惠時，為中郎將。
units.en: Under Emperor Hui he rose to general of the palace gentlemen.
units.literal: In the time of Emperor Xiaohui, he was general of the gentlemen of the palace.

units.zh: 布為河東守。
units.en: Ji Bu was appointed governor of Hedong.
units.literal: Bu was Hedong governor.

units.zh: 孝文時，人有言其賢，召欲以為御史大夫。
units.en: Under Emperor Wen, word of his talent reached the throne; he was summoned with a view to making him grandee secretary.
units.literal: In the time of Emperor Xiaowen, someone spoke of his worthiness; he was summoned with the intention of making him grandee secretary.

units.zh: 乃髡鉗布，衣褐，置廣柳車中，并與其家僮數十人，之魯朱家所賣之。
units.en: They shaved his head, clamped him in the convict's collar, dressed him in a laborer's hemp, stowed him in a funeral cart with several dozen household servants, and drove him to Zhu Jia of Lu to be sold off as a slave.
units.literal: Thereupon they shaved his head and put the iron collar on Bu, clothed him in coarse cloth, placed him in a broad-willow cart, together with several tens of his household slaves, and went to the place of Zhu Jia of Lu to sell him.

units.zh: 上乃赦布。
units.en: The emperor then granted Ji Bu a full pardon.
units.literal: The sovereign thereupon pardoned Bu.

units.zh: 布曰：「樊噲可斬也。
units.en: Ji Bu said, "Fan Kuai deserves execution.
units.literal: Bu said, "Fan Kuai can be beheaded.

units.zh: 夫以高帝兵三十餘萬，困於平城，噲時亦在其中。
units.en: Gaozu himself led over three hundred thousand men and was trapped at Pingcheng—and Fan Kuai was in that army.
units.literal: As for by Gaozu's troops of more than three hundred thousand being trapped at Pingcheng, at that time Kuai also was within them.

units.zh: 今噲奈何以十萬眾橫行匈奴中，面謾！
units.en: How dare he now boast that a mere hundred thousand could ride roughshod over the Xiongnu? He is lying to your faces!
units.literal: Now how can Kuai with a hundred thousand men rampage through the middle of the Xiongnu—lying to your faces!

units.zh: 且秦以事胡，陳勝等起。
units.en: Moreover, the Qin empire crumbled in part because it exhausted itself on the northern frontier, and Chen Sheng rose in rebellion.
units.literal: Moreover, because Qin exhausted itself on affairs with the Hu, Chen Sheng and others rose in rebellion.

units.zh: 今瘡痍未瘳，噲又面諛，欲搖動天下。」
units.en: The realm is still bleeding from those wars, and Fan Kuai flatters you to your face and would unsettle the whole empire again."
units.literal: Now the wounds are not yet healed, and Kuai again to the face flatters, wishing to shake and move the empire."

units.zh: 布進曰：「臣待罪河東，陛下無故召臣，此人必有以臣欺陛下者。
units.en: Ji Bu stepped forward and said, "I stand under sentence of fault at Hedong; Your Majesty summoned me without cause—someone must have oversold me to you.
units.literal: Bu advanced and said, "Your servant awaits punishment at Hedong; Your Majesty without reason summoned your servant—this person must have had something by which to deceive Your Majesty regarding your servant.

units.zh: 今臣至，無所受事，罷去，此人必有毀臣者。
units.en: Now that I am here, I am given no charge and dismissed—someone has blackened me behind my back.
units.literal: Now your servant has arrived, without receiving any charge, dismissed and sent away—someone must have slandered your servant.

units.zh: 夫陛下以一人譽召臣，一人毀去臣，臣恐天下有識者聞之，有以窺陛下。」
units.en: If one man's praise brings me to court and one man's slander sends me packing, thoughtful men everywhere will draw their own conclusions about Your Majesty's judgment."
units.literal: As for Your Majesty by one man's praise summoning your servant, by one man's slander sending away your servant—your servant fears the empire's knowing ones hearing it will have means to peer into Your Majesty."

units.zh: 及至困厄奴僇，苟活而不變，何也？
units.en: Yet when he was broken, enslaved, and humiliated, he clung to life without yielding his purpose—why was that?
units.literal: When it came to straits and humiliation as a slave, living ignobly yet not changing—why?

units.zh: 布匿濮陽周氏，周氏曰：「漢求將軍急，跡且至臣家，能聽臣，臣敢進計；
units.en: Ji Bu took refuge with the Zhou clan of Puyang. They told him, "The Han are hunting you relentlessly; their agents will soon be at my door. If you will trust me, I have a plan to propose;
units.literal: Bu hid with the Zhou family of Puyang. The Zhou family said, "The Han search for the general is urgent; the trail will soon reach my house. If you can heed me, I dare advance a plan;

units.zh: 布許之。
units.en: Ji Bu agreed.
units.literal: Bu assented to it.

units.zh: 滕公心知朱家大俠，意布匿其所，乃許諾。
units.en: Xiahou Ying knew Zhu Jia for a famous man of chivalry and guessed Ji Bu lay hidden with him; he agreed to speak.
units.literal: Lord Teng in his heart knew Zhu Jia was a great knight-errant; he suspected Bu was hidden at his place; thereupon he promised.

units.zh: 布之官。
units.en: Ji Bu returned to his post.
units.literal: Bu went to his office.

units.zh: 及曹丘生歸，欲得書請布。
units.en: When Cao Qiusheng came home, he wanted a letter of introduction to Ji Bu.
units.literal: When Cao Qiusheng returned, he wished to obtain a letter to request Bu.

units.zh: 使人先發書，布果大怒，待曹丘。
units.en: He had his letter sent ahead; Ji Bu flew into a rage and waited for Cao Qiusheng.
units.literal: He sent a man first to dispatch the letter; Bu indeed was greatly angry and awaited Cao Qiu.

units.zh: 布乃大說。
units.en: Ji Bu was delighted.
units.literal: Bu thereupon was greatly pleased.

units.zh: 布名所以益聞者，曹丘揚之也。
units.en: It was Cao Qiusheng's praise that made Ji Bu's name ring louder still.
units.literal: The reason Bu's name thereby increased in being heard was that Cao Qiu raised it.

units.zh: 楚莊忍絕丹姬，以成伯功；
units.en: King Zhuang of Chu renounced his favorite Dan Ji to win hegemony;
units.literal: King Zhuang of Chu endured cutting off Lady Dan, thereby to complete hegemon's merit;

units.zh: 晉文廢禮行權，以濟其業，故子犯曰，有求於人，必先從之，將奪其國，何有於妻，非無故而違禮教者也。
units.en: Duke Wen of Jin set ritual aside and used expedient power to save his cause; hence Zi Fan said that when one needs others one must first yield, and when one is about to seize a state what care is there for a wife?—that was not capricious breach of ritual.
units.literal: Duke Wen of Jin set ritual aside and exercised expedient power to save his enterprise; hence Zi Fan said: when one has need of others, one must first yield to them; about to seize their state, what care for a wife?—this was not violating ritual teaching without cause.

units.zh: 沛郡桓譚為司空掾，典其議，為甄豐言：「凡此數者，必有一是。
units.en: Huan Tan of Pei, serving as a Works clerk, oversaw the debate and told Zhen Feng: "Among these proposals, at least one is correct.
units.literal: Huan Tan of Pei commandery, as clerk in Chief Works, handled these discussions and told Zhen Feng: "Among these several proposals, one must be right.

units.zh: 宜詳考驗，皆可豫見，計定然後舉事，費不過數億萬，亦可以事諸浮食無產業民。
units.en: They should be examined and tested rigorously, since outcomes can be predicted in advance. Decide the plan first, then act. Costs should stay within a few hundred million, while also employing idle, landless populations.
units.literal: They should be carefully tested in detail; all can be foreseen. Set calculations then act. The cost will not exceed several hundred million and can also employ those floating people without livelihoods.

units.zh: 空居與行役，同當衣食；
units.en: Whether idle or in labor service, people require food and clothing all the same.
units.literal: Being idle and serving labor are alike in needing clothing and food;

units.zh: 衣食縣官，而為之作，乃兩便，可以上繼禹功，下除民疾。」
units.en: If the state feeds and clothes them while employing them in works, both sides benefit - continuing Yu's legacy above and relieving popular hardship below."
units.literal: If state provides food and clothing and has them work, it is beneficial both ways: above continue Yu's achievement, below remove people's suffering."

units.zh: 賜嗤不能東封函谷，受制於人，當似教僕賢祭仲而褒季氏。
units.en: You mock me for being unable to seal Hangu Pass in the east and for being controlled by others—it is as if you praised Jizhong and commended the Ji clan.
units.literal: You mock me for being unable to seal Hangu Pass in the east and for being controlled by others — it is as if you praised Jizhong and commended the Ji clan.

units.zh: 喜從弟孔鄉侯晏親與喜等，而女爲皇后。
units.en: Fu Xi's cousin, Marquis of Kongxiang Fu Yan, was close to him, and Yan's daughter was empress.
units.literal: Xi's younger cousin Kongxiang Marquis Yan was close with Xi and the others, and his daughter was empress.

units.zh: 喜在國三歲余，哀帝崩，平帝即位，王莽用事，免傅氏宮爵歸故郡，晏將妻子徙合浦。
units.en: Fu Xi spent three years in his fief. After Emperor Ai died and the child Emperor Ping ascended, Wang Mang took charge, stripped the Fu clan of their titles, and sent them home; Fu Yan removed his wife and children to Hepu on the southern coast.
units.literal: Xi was in his state more than three years; Emperor Ai died; Emperor Ping ascended the throne; Wang Mang handled affairs; the Fu clan's palace ranks were dismissed and they returned to their old commanderies; Yan led wife and children and moved to Hepu.

units.zh: 百官盤互，親疏相錯，骨肉大臣有申伯之忠，洞洞屬屬，小心畏忌，無重合、安陽、博陸之亂。
units.en: The bureaucracy is a web of kin and stranger, yet your kinsmen-ministers show the loyalty of Shen Bo—solemn, cautious, nothing like the Chonge, Huo, or Han clique rebellions.
units.literal: The hundred officials coil and cross; near and far mutually interlace; bone-and-flesh great ministers have Shen Bo's loyalty, in awe linked and linked, careful in fear and dread—there is no Chonge, Anyang, or Bolu disorder.

units.zh: 永陳三七之戒，斯為忠焉，至其引申伯以阿鳳，隙平阿於車騎，指金、火以求合，可謂諒不足而談有餘者。
units.en: Gu Yong's "three-seven" warning was true loyalty; yet he cited Shen Bo to flatter Wang Feng, sowed strife with Ping'a, and read Venus and Mars to suit his patrons—candor thin, words many.
units.literal: Yong stated the three-seven warning—this was loyal; as for invoking Shen Bo to flatter Feng, setting Ping'a against the General of Chariots and Cavalry, and pointing to metal and fire to seek favor, he may be called a man whose sincerity was insufficient and whose talk was excessive.

units.zh: 五月丙戌，立皇后傅氏。
units.en: In the fifth month, on the day bingxu, he installed Lady Fu as empress.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the day Bingxu, he established Empress Fu.
